title: Auto Steal
features:
**Current features:**

- **Player**
  - WalkSpeed slider
  - JumpPower slider
  - Fly + speed slider
  - Noclip
  - Infinite Jump
  - Anti AFK
  - No Gameplay Paused

- **Eggs**
  - Auto Pickup World Eggs
  - Auto Return & Deposit Eggs
  - Auto Place Eggs
  - Auto Hatch Ready Eggs
  - Egg Pickup & Place Filters
  - Best Luck / Nearest Priority
  - Optional Instant Travel To Eggs
  - Pickup Hold & Range
  - Adjustable Return Timing & Speed

- **Pets**
  - Auto Place Best Pets
  - Adjustable Placement Delay
  - Auto Ride Fastest Pet
  - Auto Collect Cash + collection delay

- **Shop & Progression**
  - Auto Buy Selected Items
  - Cash Reserve
  - Auto Rebirth
  - Auto Buy Luck Upgrades
  - Auto Unlock Nests
  - Auto Use Radar
  - Auto Claim Offline Earnings & Index Rewards

- **Visuals**
  - World Egg ESP
  - Pet Value ESP — income & stored cash
  - Only My Pets filter
  - Adjustable ESP Distance & Label Limit

- **Misc**
  - Adjustable Tween Speed
  - Activity Heartbeat
  - Account Stats Feed
  - Cash Balance Graph
